desc.zh: 从四个手算乘积推导规范项键、递归解析与稀疏多项式运算。
desc.en: Derive canonical term keys, recursive parsing and sparse polynomial arithmetic from four hand products.

complexity: O(E + n(P+1)²(D+1)log(D+2) + P log(P+1)(D+1)) key operations; O(E + n(P+1)(D+1)) auxiliary space plus output strings

concepts.name: Canonical polynomial keys
concepts.description: Sorted variable tuples preserve multiplicity and identify equal terms.

concepts.name: Polynomial parser invariant
concepts.description: Each returned coefficient map denotes exactly its consumed subexpression after substitution.

concepts.name: Sparse polynomial multiplication
concepts.description: Distribute every pair and combine coefficients for matching canonical keys.
